title: Leasing and screening
description: We price the home from real comparables, photograph it properly, and show it within two days of a request.
includes: Rent analysis · Listing and showings · Income, credit and history checks · Lease signing

title: Rent collection
description: Residents pay online. Late rent gets a reminder on the 2nd and a formal notice on the 6th — the same way, every time.
includes: Online payments · Late notices · Deposit accounting · Monthly owner statements

title: Maintenance
description: Requests come in through the resident portal and get a reply the same day. Anything over $300 waits for your approval.
includes: 24/7 emergency line · Vetted local trades · Photos before and after · Annual inspections

title: Renewals and move-outs
description: Renewal offers go out 60 days ahead. At move-out we compare the home against the day-one photos, item by item.
includes: Renewal pricing · Move-out inspection · Itemized deposit returns · Turnover scheduling
